top.line: A debrief of Neo4j's Relate, and how it compares with our graphs as JSON in encrypted, versioned vaults.

in-short.line: What Relate is; well made for its shape; where it does not fit; our graphs; each wins; together in LETS.

what.line: Embedded Rust graph database: openCypher, vectors, full-text, MCP, agent CLI, WASM, seven languages.

fit.line: One app, one machine, in memory, one writer; no TLS, one shared credential, no roles.

ours.line: Graphs as JSON files in sgit vaults: encrypted, one GET per file, versioned, many writers, nothing running.

compare.line: Relate wins at traversals, Cypher, transactions and agent ergonomics; we win at encryption, history, writers, size.

together.line: Relate is the right shape for the Transform step of Load, Extract, Transform, Save.

limits.line: Not benchmarked; our numbers from sgit.ai; different work; the combination is a proposal.

sources.line: Neo4j's press release, relatedb.ai docs, sgit.ai's performance page and earlier articles.
